text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 327 October 31, 1973
AMENDING PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 213, DATED JUNE 16, 1973, BY EXTENDING THE
PERIOD GRANTED THEREIN UP TO NOVEMBER 30, 1973
WHEREAS, the period granting amnesty to persons who are required by law to file income tax returns but
failed to do so, will end on October 31, 1973;
WHEREAS, the entire country has had inclement weather for the past few weeks brought about by three
typhoons that have caused considerable damage to public and private properties, unexpected financial
difficulties among the poorer sectors of the community and considerable delay in the campaign;
WHEREAS, there is still a considerable number of non-filers who desire to take advantage of the tax amnesty
and may not be able to do so on account of lack of material time if the deadline is not extended.
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers in
me vested by the Constitution as Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of the Philippines, and pursuant
to Proclamation No. 1081 dated September 21, 1972, and General Order No. 1 dated September 22, 1972, as
amended, do hereby order and decree that Paragraph No. 3 of Presidential Decree No. 213 is hereby amended
to read as follows:
"3. The amount or amounts payable, as provided above, must be paid in full upon filing of the income tax
return or returns which shall not be later than November 30, 1973, and such payment shall entitle the person
making the return to all the immunities provided in Presidential Decree No. 23, as amended."
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 31st day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
